summary.text: Wendy Hoy is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 57 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Adam Anderson.
Her career has included work as a teacher, hospice educator, assisted living administrator and Head Start center director, according to her Ballotpedia survey response.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Hoy earned a high school diploma from Massapequa High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Michigan in 1973, and Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a healthcare consultant.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she began her professional life as a teacher and later worked in home health and hospice education, and that she has served as an assisted living administrator, a guardian ad litem and the director of three Head Start centers.
She also said she has volunteered as a hotline advocate, served on nonprofit boards supporting foster children, and is active in Kiwanis and as a Friends board member of her local public library.

Hoy said in the survey that her campaign priorities include reducing property taxes, expanding affordable housing and ensuring that every eligible voter can cast a ballot without unnecessary barriers.
